verdict.summary: Round 5 finds no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The new public WAC and ACP entry points pass the same cooperative QueryBudget through the variable-graph authorization SELECT and the real DELETE/INSERT-WHERE application, while preserving the unlimited legacy path. Budget exhaustion during authorization returns before mutation; apply-side tests assert full store snapshots remain unchanged for a single operation, and positive controls prove the authorized update really executes. The ACP and MCP coverage likewise includes authorization and successful-write controls, so the abort assertions are not vacuous. Documentation consistently limits the claim to SPARQL evaluation, explicitly excludes CLEAR, DROP, and LOAD, and accurately discloses multi-operation non-atomicity and caller-side ceilings. This is materially the same clean result as round 4, so progress is stagnant under the required scale. No instruction-like prompt injection appears in the diff.
